# freshdesk_ticket_fields (Data Source)

Every field on the ticket form, built-in and custom. Useful for finding the generated `name` of a custom field.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Useful for finding the generated `name` of a custom field, which is what
# `custom_fields` on a ticket or contact is keyed by.
data "freshdesk_ticket_fields" "all" {}

output "custom_field_names" {
  value = [for f in data.freshdesk_ticket_fields.all.ticket_fields : f.name if !f.default]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `ticket_fields`.
- `ticket_fields` (Attributes List) Every ticket field the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ticket_fields))

<a id="nestedatt--ticket_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ticket_fields`

Read-Only:

- `choices` (String) Dropdown options, as JSON.
- `created_at` (String) When the field was created (RFC 3339).
- `customers_can_edit` (Boolean) Whether customers may edit the field.
- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is a built-in field.
- `description` (String) Help text shown beneath the field.
- `displayed_to_customers` (Boolean) Whether the field appears in the portal.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the ticket field.
- `label` (String) Label shown to agents.
- `label_for_customers` (String) Label shown in the customer portal.
- `name` (String) Internal name of the field.
- `position` (Number) Position of the field on the form.
- `required_for_agents` (Boolean) Whether agents must fill the field in.
- `required_for_closure` (Boolean) Whether the field is needed to close a ticket.
- `required_for_customers` (Boolean) Whether customers must fill the field in.
- `type` (String) Field type.
- `updated_at` (String) When the field was last changed (RFC 3339).
